asserts: Vision running in shadow records a comparison and changes nothing that is published. Shadow mode is only meaningful if it is provably inert, and this is the case that proves it.

vision_estimator.funded: TBD - vision funding and cost ceiling are open questions in ADR-023
vision_estimator.note: Well below the published point estimate. Consistent with the occlusion undercount ADR-023 expects from any optical method.

expected.promotion_gate: must beat feed-derived accuracy against census anchors at acceptable cost, per ADR-022 promotion pattern
expected.notes_on_expectation: The comparison accumulates the evidence that would one day justify promotion. Until then it is inert by construction, not by policy.

must_not: alter the published point estimate or interval
widen the interval because the shadow estimator disagreed
raise a population-change flag from the shadow estimator
promote the estimator on a single favourable comparison
surface the shadow figure to keepers as though it were an estimate of the colony
notes: The 28-fish gap is the point of the case rather than an accident of the fixture. An optical estimator is expected to undercount a dense school, and the undercount scales with density, which is the quantity being measured. A shadow period exists to measure that bias against census anchors before anyone is asked to trust it.
